title: Temporary Power
text: Only intended to drive certain machines temporarily.

With both hands empty, aim at a pulse receiver, Arcane Wire or accumulator orb and hold Use for 5 seconds. Rings rise from your feet; five rings surround you once power begins. A short press retains the normal interaction.
Your supply in MPU equals ten times your natural mana recovery per second. While supplying, natural recovery pauses without consuming stored mana. Recovery continues during charging.
Keep holding Use and aiming at the receiver. Releasing, looking away or holding an item in either hand stops the supply.
